gripOrHq.title: Fatal Attractor
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] The next time Runner encounters a piece of ice during the run, do 3 Net damage unless Runner breaks all subroutines of that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Nevinyrral
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Gain an action during each of your turns. If Nevinyrral leaves play while rezzed, you lose the game.
Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

discardCards.title: Top Runners' Conference
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

discardCards.title: Top Runners' Conference
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

discardCards.title: Loan from Chiba
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: Joan of Arc
discardCards.rulesText:
[T]: Prevent one or more of your other installed programs from being trashed.
[1]: Prevent one or more of your other installed programs from being trashed, and bring Joan of Arc into your hand.

discardCards.title: Shield
discardCards.rulesText: Prevents up to 2 Net damage each turn.

rig.title: R&D-Protocol Files
rig.rulesText: A: Make a run on R&D, but instead of accessing cards, look at the top five cards of R&D.

rig.title: Shield
rig.rulesText: Prevents up to 2 Net damage each turn.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

ice.title: Mastiff
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 brain damage. *Do 1 Net damage. *For the remainder of the run, all ice is encountered at +1 strength. *Trace 5-If trace is successful, give Runner a Mastiff counter. Each Mastiff counter does 1 brain damage at the start of each run. Runner may remove a Mastiff counter by taking an action to spend [4]. *End the run.

ice.title: Cerberus
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 3 Net damage.
[Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a Cerberus counter. Each Cerberus counter does 2 Net damage at the start of each run. Runner may remove a Cerberus counter by taking an action to spend [4].
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Nerve Labyrinth
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: TRAP!
root.rulesText: If you pay [4] when Runner accesses TRAP!, it does 3 Net damage and gives Runner a tag, even if TRAP! is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If TRAP! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

ice.title: Fragmentation Storm
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 4 - If trace is successful, end the run and trash a program, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [1].

root.title: Crybaby
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Crybaby, give Runner a Crying counter. Each Crying counter reduces Runner's link by 2 during each trace attempt. Runner can remove a Crying counter by taking an action to pay [2].

ice.title: Homewrecker™
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, end the run, trash a piece of hardware, and do 2 meat damage. This damage cannot be prevented.
